page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes at the left side (three short notes beside the lines "Sic tradidē", "Antiquū" and "pharisæi"); a running head at the top.

main_text.p: affistentium, prælatum dominum Ioannem Oldcastellum militem, dominum de Cobham, de et super huiusmodi detestabili reatu conuictu, et ad ecclesiæ unitatem, pœnitentia liter redire nolentem, hæreticum, ac in his, quæ tenet, docet, determinauit prædicat sacrosancta Romana et uniuersalis ecclesia, & præsertim in articulis supra scriptis errantem, iudicauimus, declarauimus, & condemnauimus sententialiter, & diffini ue in his scriptis, relinquentes eundem ex nunc tanquam hæreticum iudicio seculari. Ipsumque nihilominus hæreticum, omnesque alios & sigulos qui eundem de cætero in fui fauorem erroris receptauerit, uel receptauerint, defensauerit, seu defensauerint, sibi cosilium, auxilium seu fauorem in hac parte præbuit uel præbuerint tanquam fautores, receptatores & defensatores hæreticorum excomunicauimus, & excommuni-
Sic tradidē runt phas rifei Chri stum Pila to.

page.notes: Margin notes are partly illegible; the marginal note texts are read as printed. The word "excomunicauimus" and the line-ending "muni-" are as printed. Several words are uncertain due to the scan and the faded print.
